description: Election Commission - Declare that A. U. K. G. Karunarathne as a Member of the Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter.
